_comment: Copy to config.json (or use the ARTEX_CONFIG environment variable to specify a different path). This file only contains database and skill_dir; LLM and other configuration is handled via environment variables or in-app settings, not in this file.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. Precedence: environment variable ARTEX_PG_DSN > database in this file. Choose one of two formats: (A) fill in the per-field values below; (B) fill in only a single full connection string at database.dsn.
_comment_database_dsn: Format (B): remove the database block above and use a full DSN instead. When dsn is non-empty, the per-field values are ignored.
_comment_skill_dir: Skill root directory (one skill per subdirectory, each containing SKILL.md). Precedence: environment variable ARTEX_SKILL_DIR > this field > default (skills/ next to the executable). Leave empty or remove this field to use the default. Relative paths are resolved against the current working directory.
